notes.title: Natural IK Release - New Motion Studio Update
notes.content:
We have built a new feature called Natural IK to allow more unique animation opportunities.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40157672/8e0420287642a5ec2bd8dbb8c4d0ca28a219a425.png


 You can turn on and off IK for Arms and Legs.
 Reposition animations to create unique offsets.
 Support moving motions as well.


Please note there may be bugs present but please let us know if anything is breaking for you.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40157672/64e825eede60372d586e81cb77c7c4026fd1b111.png

We are pushing another update shortly with new animations as well. We will outline the new animations in that update log.

Thanks again for waiting for these new updates, COVID really threw us a curveball. ːsteamhappyː

It's here, the new Motion Studio update with Neural Network retargeting support.

New animations are included in this release:

 Falling

 Fixed retargeting error that would occur when bones were imported on a different coordinate system.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 2nd May 2021

notes.title: Patch Notes - 1st May 2021
notes.content:
Brand New Retargeter - For Unity and Unreal Engine

Rebuilt for ease of use, simply import the rig you use in your preferred engine or software, retarget the bones and apply what motion you like in Motion Studio, export back to either Unity or Unreal Engine from Motion Studio and import onto your existing mesh. 


 Bones are aligned automatically to match the coordinate space of the engine in use, now there won't be errors generated from incorrect bone rotations. 
 Export Retargeter is x2 as fast as before as we removed a lot of overheard from the codebase running the calculations.


https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0042/9319/7922/articles/MotionStudioRetarget_1200x.png?v=1619874388
^ Inside Motion Studio

https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0042/9319/7922/files/UnityRetarget_480x480.png?v=1619874312
^ Imported from Motion Studio in Unity

https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0042/9319/7922/files/UnrealJogFwd_480x480.png?v=1619874350
^ Imported from Motion Studio in Unreal Engine

If you use an engine other than Unity and Unreal please let us know in the forums on Steam so we can make a new option in the software.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 29th April 2021
notes.content:
New Feature Released - Rotation Gizmo

A new feature has been developed for Motion Studio for managing your custom offsets in the Editor - Rotation Gizmo.

Using the rotation gizmo you can visually offset and manage rotations with ease. Simply select a bone in the editor and the Rotation Gizmo will appear in the viewport (press E to show and hide it). 

From there you can manipulate the gizmo and it will offset the animation live - even while it's playing! 

https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0042/9319/7922/files/GizmoUpdate1_480x480.gif?v=1619677393
